purpose: Grade whether the Fable 5 compounding loop can start, run, verify, and improve through the three tiers and four compound-stack layers.

criteria.description: The loop contract defines exactly three tiers: capability/routing, orchestration primitives, and self-improvement.
The compound stack defines exactly four layers: primitives, orchestration, memory, and self-improvement.
The outcome rubric and skill require an independent verifier instead of maker self-critique.
STATE.md contains verified facts, general rules, open failures, lessons learned, and last-session sections.
The skill explains when durable lessons are added and rejects one-off task progress or guesses.
A routine template documents trigger, roles, run protocol, digest, and guardrails.
Safety-boundary and protected 27vette-boundary failures are handled as fallback/escalation cases.
scripts/validate_fable5_loop.py passes against the repository artifacts.
Every non-trivial run leaves outcome, verifier report, validation output, and run.json receipt artifacts.
STATE.md durable memory entries include ISO dates or timestamps plus Evidence references.
Run receipts point to verifier reports with verdict, criteria, and inspected evidence.
Run receipts record whether the compounding skill was updated, deferred, or not applicable, with evidence.
